item.title: What kind of attack drones does Iran have and could they reach the US West Coast?
item.description: The FBI has reportedly warned California police departments that Iran could retaliate for U.S. attacks by launching drones at the West Coast.

item.title: How SoCal heat waves affect parts of the region differently
item.description: How Southern Californians experience the heat wave varies depending on several factors, a NASA study shows.

item.title: Leavitt pushes back against report of FBI warning of Iran threat to California
item.description: Leavitt said "no such threat from Iran to our homeland exists, and it never did.”

item.title: Savannah Bananas make highly anticipated return to San Diego
item.description: The Savannah Bananas are returning to Petco Park in San Diego on March 21 and 22 to take on the Loco Beach Coconuts, with tickets available through the Banana Ball Ticket Lottery List and StubHub.

item.title: Two California cities rank in top 20 of hardest places to live with allergies
item.description: The Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America (AAFA) conducted an Allergy Capitals report for 2026, ranking the largest 100 cities in the contiguous U.S. by how challenging they are to live in if you have a pollen allergy, with Boise, Idaho, ranking first and two major California cities, San Diego and San Francisco, making the list.

item.title: Report proposes roadmap to addressing Tijuana River sewage crisis
item.description: The San Diego Regional Chamber of Commerce published a report providing a framework to improve the Tijuana River sewage crisis, which has caused health, environmental, and economic concerns for many in the South Bay.

item.title: Kamala Harris cancels 3 book tour stops in California, including San Diego
item.description: Kamala Harris has cancelled several book tour visits in California, including her April 6 stop in San Diego, due to a scheduling conflict.

item.title: Local surfer helps rescue man who jumped from Oceanside pier
item.description: A local surfer rescued a man who had jumped from the Oceanside Pier into the ocean, and the Oceanside Fire Department wants to recognize the surfer's quick response.

item.title: Family of Clairemont hit-and-run victim search for clues in case
item.description: A local woman is searching for justice after her brother who was killed in a hit-and-run in Clairemont earlier this month.

item.title: San Diego police arrest woman for slashing Starbucks worker
item.description: A woman injured a Starbucks coffee shop employee with a knife and was arrested for assault with a deadly weapon and burglary on Thursday, San Diego police said.
